shots.framing: B-roll: a student teacher holding up a visual aid to a row of younger kids.
shots.camera: Slow pan right from teacher to the kids
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: student teacher holds up a visual aid

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

graphics.title: BIBLE TEACHING
graphics.subtitle: JUNIOR & SENIOR HIGH
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Picture a room full of fourth to sixth graders. You've got a few minutes to teach them something from the Bible they'll remember. That's Bible Teaching.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for teachers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Bible Teaching is open to young men and young women in Junior and Senior High. Each school can enter three per division.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: You're teaching to grades four through six.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Junior High teaches six to eight minutes. Senior High, eight to ten.

graphics.title: TIME LIMITS
graphics.subtitle: TEACH GRADES 4–6 · JR 6–8 · SR 8–10 MIN
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: You'll get a one-minute warning sign. When time's up, you're stopped. So practice with a timer.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Every lesson needs an original audio or visual aid. Make it yourself.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: The lesson has to be your own work, too. Borrow ideas and use reference books for background. Just don't copy someone else's lesson.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Keep class interaction to ten percent of your time or less. In an eight-minute lesson, that's under a minute.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: When you present, hand the judges three typed copies of your lesson outline, plus three judging sheets.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your outline lists your objectives and the principles you'll teach.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Then your Scripture references, the materials you need, a short summary and a bibliography.

graphics.title: YOUR OUTLINE
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Remember Second Timothy two, verse two: "commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also." Teach like it matters, because it does.

shots.storyboard_caption: P2 close-up, quotes Second Timothy two, two

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Teach to the kids. Bring a visual. Bring your outline.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
